title: Bertillot et al. 2026: analysis code and pretrained U-Net models
description:
Analysis code and pretrained models for Bertillot, F., Hervé, S., Outla, Z. et al. Heterogeneity co-evolves with architecture to determine colon cancer outcome (manuscript in revision, 2026).

The repository contains the notebooks and helper modules for tumour architecture analysis of colorectal cancer tissue microarrays (tumour–stroma segmentation, architecture classification, morphology and neighbourhood features), nuclear shape analysis, and GeoMx spatial transcriptomics analysis.

It includes the two pretrained ZeroCostDL4Mic 2D multilabel U-Nets used in the paper (Keras .h5, 512×512 single-channel pan-cadherin input): the tumour–stroma U-Net (models/tumor_stroma_unet.h5, trained on 30 TMA cores) and the architecture U-Net (models/architecture_unet.h5, trained on 196 archetype TMA cores; stored in four parts, reassembled with models/join_architecture_unet.py). ONNX exports of the architecture U-Net and inference code are available at doi:10.5281/zenodo.20343193.

Patient images and data are not included; see the paper's Data availability statement.
